SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'EUR') AS eur_customer_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'CZK') AS czk_customer_count,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'EUR')::NUMERIC
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'), 0),
    4
  ) AS eur_to_czk_ratio
FROM customers c
WHERE c.currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK');

SELECT
    ym.customer_id,
    SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'LAM'
  AND ym.date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY ym.customer_id
ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  AVG(ym.consumption) / 12 AS avg_monthly_consumption_sme_2013
FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c
  ON ym.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'SME'
  AND LEFT(ym.date, 4) = '2013';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN CAST(ym.consumption AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END) AS czk_consumption_2012,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN CAST(ym.consumption AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END) AS eur_consumption_2012,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN CAST(ym.consumption AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN CAST(ym.consumption AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_difference
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c
  ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
WHERE ym.date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
SELECT LEFT(date, 4) AS year, SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth GROUP BY LEFT(date, 4) ORDER BY total_consumption DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ym.date AS year_month, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'SME'
  AND ym.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY ym.date
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
  SELECT ym.customer_id,
         SUM(ym.consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY ym.customer_id
),
customer_segment AS (
  SELECT ct.customer_id,
         ct.annual_consumption,
         c.segment
  FROM czk_2013 ct
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id
  WHERE c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT segment,
         MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_segment
  GROUP BY segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
  SELECT cs.segment,
         cs.annual_consumption
  FROM customer_segment cs
  JOIN segment_min sm
    ON sm.segment = cs.segment
   AND sm.min_consumption = cs.annual_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
  SELECT segment,
         SUM(annual_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM lowest_customers
  GROUP BY segment
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
         MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
         MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
  FROM segment_avg
)
SELECT sme_avg - lam_avg AS sme_minus_lam,
       lam_avg - kam_avg AS lam_minus_kam,
       kam_avg - sme_avg AS kam_minus_sme
FROM pivoted;

WITH eur_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, segment
  FROM customers
  WHERE currency = 'EUR'
    AND segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
consumption_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    LEFT(ym.date, 4) AS yr,
    SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  INNER JOIN eur_customers c ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE LEFT(ym.date, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.segment, LEFT(ym.date, 4)
),
segment_totals AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE yr = '2012') AS consumption_2012,
    MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE yr = '2013') AS consumption_2013
  FROM consumption_by_year
  GROUP BY segment
),
segment_pct AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    consumption_2013 - consumption_2012 AS increase_or_decrease,
    ROUND((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / NULLIF(consumption_2013, 0) * 100, 4) AS pct_increase
  FROM segment_totals
)
SELECT
  'Biggest percentage increase' AS result_type,
  segment,
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  increase_or_decrease,
  pct_increase
FROM segment_pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM segment_pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Lowest percentage increase' AS result_type,
  segment,
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  increase_or_decrease,
  pct_increase
FROM segment_pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM segment_pct)
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;
SELECT SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE customer_id = 6 AND date >= '201308' AND date <= '201311';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gs.country = 'CZE') AS cze_discount_stations,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gs.country = 'SVK') AS svk_discount_stations,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gs.country = 'CZE') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gs.country = 'SVK') AS difference
FROM gasstations gs
WHERE gs.segment = 'Discount';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sme_czk_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sme_eur_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_czk_minus_eur,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       > SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS more_smes_pay_czk
FROM customers
WHERE segment = 'SME';

SELECT
    ROUND(
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_total_amount > 46.73) * 100.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
      4
    ) AS pct_lam_customers_over_threshold
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS customer_total_amount
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t
      ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.segment = 'LAM'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
) AS customer_totals

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE consumption > 528.3)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS pct_customers_above_threshold
FROM yearmonth
WHERE date = '201202';

SELECT
  date AS year_month,
  CAST(consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE LEFT(date, 4) = '2012'
ORDER BY CAST(consumption AS DOUBLE PRECISION) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.description
FROM products p
JOIN transactions_1k t ON p.product_id = t.product_id
JOIN yearmonth y ON t.customer_id = y.customer_id
  AND to_char(t.date, 'YYYYMM') = y.date
WHERE y.date = '201309';

SELECT DISTINCT gs.country
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN transactions_1k t ON t.customer_id = ym.customer_id
JOIN gasstations gs ON gs.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id
WHERE ym.date = '201306'
ORDER BY gs.country;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS euro_customers_with_monthly_consumption_over_1000
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
  AND ym.consumption > 1000;

SELECT DISTINCT p.description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON g.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = t.product_id WHERE g.country = 'CZE' ORDER BY p.description;

SELECT DISTINCT t.time
FROM transactions_1k AS t
INNER JOIN gasstations AS gs
  ON gs.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id
WHERE gs.chain_id = 11
ORDER BY t.time;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.gas_station_id = g.gas_station_id WHERE g.country = 'CZE' AND t.date > DATE '2012-01-01'

SELECT c.currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-24'
  AND t.time = TIME '16:25:00';

SELECT c.segment AS segment
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c
  ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-23'
  AND t.time = TIME '21:20:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON g.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-26'
  AND t.time BETWEEN TIME '08:00:00' AND TIME '09:00:00'
  AND g.country = 'CZE';

SELECT c.customer_id, c.segment, c.currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = '2012-08-24'
  AND t.price = 548.4;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0
    * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN t.customer_id END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id), 0),
    2
  ) AS pct_eur_customers
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c
  ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-25';

WITH target_customer AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_id
  FROM transactions_1k AS t
  WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-25'
    AND t.price = 634.8
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    y.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN target_customer AS tc
    ON tc.customer_id = y.customer_id
  GROUP BY y.customer_id
)
SELECT
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearly;

SELECT
  segment,
  COUNT(*) AS segment_count,
  SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM gasstations
WHERE country = 'SVK'
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment_count DESC;

SELECT 38508 AS customer_id,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.amount)
                 FROM transactions_1k t
                 WHERE t.customer_id = 38508), 0) AS total_spent_at_gas_stations,
       COALESCE((SELECT y.consumption
                 FROM yearmonth y
                 WHERE y.customer_id = 38508
                   AND y.date = '201201'), 0) AS spent_january_2012;

WITH customer_spending AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(price) AS total_spending,
    SUM(price) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS avg_price_per_item
  FROM transactions_1k
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
top_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_id, total_spending, avg_price_per_item
  FROM customer_spending
  ORDER BY total_spending DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t.customer_id,
  t.total_spending,
  t.avg_price_per_item,
  c.currency
FROM top_customer t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id

SELECT
    ym.customer_id,
    ym.consumption
FROM yearmonth AS ym
WHERE ym.date = '201208'
  AND ym.customer_id IN (
    SELECT t.customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.product_id = 5
      AND t.amount > 0
      AND (t.price / t.amount) > 29.00
  )
ORDER BY ym.consumption DESC;
